text:
neil: Heads-up - Aurora wants a migration POC from CompetitorZ to Redwood. Scope: generate, chat streaming, embeddings. They need parity checks, pricing delta, and security answers. Target demo in 7 business days. Who owns what?
rachael: Surface deltas to call out: tokenization on curly quotes/emoji, default stop handling, and streaming chunk format. We'll implement a tiny compat shim in the POC.
vik: Pricing plan: I'll model hosted vs dedicated vs hybrid for their current volumes (est. 3M gen tokens, 600k embed tokens/mo). Will show break-even and a simple sample invoice conversion.
sec-bot: Security ticket created: S-9810 assigned to rachael. Need SOC2 artifacts, SSO metadata, KMS diagram.
neil: Technical plan: 1) lightweight proxy mapping headers and errors 2) prompt normalizer for stops + defaults 3) smoke tests: 150 seed prompts, 25 chat sessions, embeddings corpus. Include deterministic temperature=0 runs.
rachael: For KMS note: Private supports customer-managed keys; HSM adds ~10 business days. Hosted can offer encrypted blobs via dedicated if needed. I'll prepare the questionnaire entries and a short network diagram.
vik: I'll run a 48h synthetic and gather token counts, tokenization delta, latency p95, and a semantic fuzz score for chat.
neil: Ops, can you provision a POC env? Need allowlist IPs and a short demo key.
sec-bot: POC env created: redwood-poc-aurora-175555. Access TTL 21 days. Logs retention default 7 days.
neil: Owners: Rachael - security + questionnaire + KMS wording. Vik - pricing + synthetic run. Rachael/Vik - help me with a 3-bullet behavior-diff summary for the demo.
rachael: Behavior bullets: 1) small tokenization offsets on special punctuation, 2) trailing newline handling in structured JSON outputs, 3) streaming chunk boundary differences.
vik: I'll upload pricing table and initial synthetic results by Friday.
neil: Schedule: dry run 24h before customer demo. Call out any blockers by EOD Monday. :thumbsup:
